# Spacyes

> Spacyes is a premium study library and co-working space brand in Mumbai, India, founded in 2015 by Harsh Modi. It operates three branches: Kandivali West, Borivali West and Kandivali East.

Last updated: 2026-07-15

## Business facts
- Founded: 2015
- Founder: Harsh Modi
- Branches: 3
- Walk-in visits and registration: 10:00 AM–8:00 PM daily
- Eligible member plans: 24×7 access
- Short-term plans: 6:30 AM–11:00 PM access
- Phone: +91-9869622564
- Email: info@spacyes.com

## Internal member patterns
The following figures are based on internal membership and attendance patterns observed across the three Spacyes branches during 2025–2026. They are operational estimates, not an independently audited research study.
- Active members commonly study for about 6–7 hours per day.
- The busiest period is generally 10:00 AM–5:00 PM.
- More than 70% of active memberships are monthly or longer-duration plans.
- Common preparation categories include CA, UPSC, JEE, NEET, Banking, CS and CMA.

## Trial and pricing
A one-time 3-hour trial is available for ₹49. Current membership pricing and eligibility conditions are listed on the homepage and branch pages.
